name: When is framing required during a home remodel?

mainEntity.name: When is framing required during a home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: You need custom framing whenever you reconfigure room layouts, open up walls, add closets, or build new partitions in basements and garages. Framing creates the essential structural skeleton before mechanical work begins. At HH Remodeling LLC, framing is handled directly by owner Abraham Becerra and his carpentry crew to ensure precise alignment for the trades that follow. Proper framing establishes square corners and level stud walls, which directly impacts the quality of subsequent drywall hanging, tile installation, and finish trim. If you skip careful framing, uneven surfaces will show up later in your tilework or baseboards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framing is required whenever you alter layouts, remove or add walls, build out basements, or create openings for doors, closets, and windows.
